summary_en: Update to August 2024 capital-cost management initiative. Specific targets and progress metrics disclosed in attached material; full details require reference to supplementary document.
title_en: Update on Initiatives to Realise Management with Awareness of Cost of Capital and Share Price
translation_en_brief: On 13 August 2026, WILLPLUS Holdings Corporation released an update to its capital-cost and share-price-focused management initiatives previously announced on 14 August 2024. The disclosure is structured as a progress report, with specific targets, revised metrics, and performance data contained in an attached supplementary document. The two-page press release header provides no standalone numeric detail; the full update—including any revised KPI targets, execution progress, and forward guidance—is referenced as contained in the attachment entitled 'Capital Cost Management: Update'. No specific ROE, margin, payout-ratio, or other quantitative targets are stated in the main text of this filing.
